text:
zoe: hi everyone, quick first-week question — the onboarding doc links to a Grafana "Service Map" dashboard but the URL 404s. i can open other dashboards but not that one. also Sentry project shows only summary events (no stack traces) and the Datadog APM link in the runbook sends me to a staging org. any pointers?

infra-bot: Welcome to Redwood! To request observability access run `open-access-request` or post your @redwood email here and an admin will help.

mica: hey zoe, welcome :wave: — can you paste your work email? Grafana Service Map got moved into a new folder (`Observability/v2`) after the dashboard reorg. Sentry and Datadog are gated by group membership, so likely a group mismatch.

zoe: zoe.liu@redwood.com. thanks — i tried the re-login + cookie clear but still get a 403 on that dashboard link.

rudy: fwiw, the Service Map panel was split into two dashboards: "Service Topology" (interactive map) and "Service Calls (table)". try Dashboards -> Observability -> Service Topology (v2). embed/panel links changed to include `?orgId=3` after the move.

mica: i've added you to `observability-read` and the Grafana folder ACL. also submitted a Datadog read role and Sentry project membership for the API team. you should get invites in ~2-3 mins — accept and then hard refresh.

zoe: got the Sentry invite email and accepted; stack traces still collapsed to summaries. is there a toggle?

mica: Sentry scrubs payloads by default on prod. to see full stack frames for debugging we do a temporary elevated view — open a short-lived access request and tag `security+api-team`. they usually approve 2-hour sessions for reproducing issues.

rudy: tip for sharing visuals in PRs: use Grafana Panel -> Share -> Snapshot -> External link or export as PNG via Panel -> Share -> Direct link rendered image. if you use an iframe it will 403 for external reviewers. for internal docs use the iframe only after confirming the reviewer is in `observability-read`.

infra-bot: Access change recorded: zoe.liu@redwood.com -> Grafana:viewer, Group:observability-read, Datadog:read (pending), Sentry:member (pending).

zoe: after accepting the invites i can view Service Topology and the calls table now — thanks! Datadog still pending but i can open APM if i copy the org param rudy mentioned. one last thing: can i request a low-severity latency monitor for my feature cluster?

mica: monitor creation is limited to SRE or service owners. if it's for a short-lived feature env, open a Monitoring Change Request in the infra handbook and tag `sre-oncall`. they typically create low-severity monitors for feature validation.

rudy: if you want, i can do a 10-min screen share and show the common dashboards and where the export/share options live.

zoe: that'd be great — 11:30 works for me. thanks everyone, this made onboarding way smoother :relieved:
